This sample is part of the "PPG
MULTISAMPLE 010 Little Mad Dance" sample pack. It is a digital sound
with a melodic element in it and some wild variations when changing
from pitch across the keyboard. Especially the higher notes on the
keyboard have some harsh digital distortion. In the sample pack there
are 16 samples evenly spread across 5 octaves (C1 till C6). The note in
the sample name (C, E or G#) does not indicate the pitch of the sound
but the key on my keyboard. The sound was created on the PPG VSTi. After that normalising and fades where applied within Cubase SX.
